g.title: icts_meso_layer_contact_change → sic_macro_layer_entropy upward Quarantine-associated contact-volume contractions that differ by layer redistribute mixing opportunities among settings, which can shift transmission toward less-contracted layers and thereby reshape the city-level distribution of infection events across layers.

g.title: sic_macro_layer_entropy → icts_macro_city_contact_change_on_quarantine_increase intra_scale A more dispersed or concentrated distribution of infection events across layers indicates which settings are driving transmission; this changes which settings generate quarantine increases and how city-level contact volume changes when quarantine counts rise.

g.title: icts_macro_city_contact_change_on_quarantine_increase → sic_macro_layer_entropy intra_scale City contact-volume changes on quarantine-increase steps can reduce contacts unevenly across layers; by suppressing mixing in some settings more than others, these changes reshape the relative occurrence of infection events across settings and therefore the layer entropy of infection events.

g.title: N3 | sic_macro_layer_entropy City infection-event layer entropy Scale: macro | Phenomenon: setting_infection_clustering Definition: For run r and window [s,s+W-1], let n_L = # infection-transition events with layer L for each non-null layer label L observed in r; N=sum_L n_L; p_L=n_L/N; K=# non-null layer labels observed in r in contacts or events; H = -(sum_L p_L log p_L)/log K if N>0 and K>1; undefined otherwise. N5 | icts_meso_layer_contact_change Layer contact-volume change around quarantine-count increase Scale: meso | Phenomenon: intervention_contact_trajectory_shift Definition: For run r and layer L, let Q_t=model_states.quarantined at step t. Let S={t: Q_t>Q_prev(t) with previous sampled step observed}. For each t in S, define C_pre(t)=mean over u in [t-W,t-1] intersect observed steps of # contacts rows with run_id=r, layer=L, step=u; C_post(t)=mean over u in [t+1,t+W] intersect observed steps of # contacts rows with run_id=r, layer=L, step=u. Indicator = median over t in S of (C_post(t)-C_pre(t)) when S and required pre/post steps exist; undefined if S is empty or no pre/post observed steps exist. N6 | icts_macro_city_contact_change_on_quarantine_increase City contact-volume change on quarantine-increase steps Scale: macro | Phenomenon: intervention_contact_trajectory_shift Definition: For run r, let C_t=# contacts rows at step t; DeltaC_t=C_t-C_{t-1}; DeltaQ_t=Q_t-Q_{t-1} from model_states.quarantined. Let A=mean{DeltaC_t: DeltaQ_t>0 and both t and t-1 are observed}; B=mean{DeltaC_t: DeltaQ_t=0 and both t and t-1 are observed}. Indicator=A-B. Undefined if A or B has no members.
